postconditions: Both models are loaded and visible
State fields are initialized with valid values

action.code: const dropdown = document.querySelector('select'); if (dropdown && dropdown.options.length > 1) { dropdown.selectedIndex = 1; dropdown.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }

postconditions: Shoe material variant index has changed to 1
New variant is visually applied to the shoe model

action.code: const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); const iridSlider = Array.from(sliders).find(s => s.min === '0' && s.max === '1' && s.step === '0.01'); const iorSlider = Array.from(sliders).find(s => parseFloat(s.min) === 1.0 && parseFloat(s.max) === 2.33); if (iridSlider) { iridSlider.value = 0.75; iridSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } if (iorSlider) { iorSlider.value = 1.8; iorSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }

const colorPicker = document.querySelector('input[type="color"]'); if (colorPicker) { colorPicker.value = '#ff6600'; colorPicker.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); const intensitySlider = Array.from(sliders).find(s => parseFloat(s.min) === 0 && parseFloat(s.max) === 5); if (intensitySlider) { intensitySlider.value = 3.5; intensitySlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }

const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); const rotSlider = Array.from(sliders).find(s => parseFloat(s.min) === 0 && parseFloat(s.max) === 360); if (rotSlider) { rotSlider.value = 180; rotSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }

postconditions: Lamp rotation angle set to 180 degrees
Lamp position updated to opposite side of shoe

action.code: const dropdown = document.querySelector('select'); if (dropdown && dropdown.options.length > 2) { dropdown.selectedIndex = 2; dropdown.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }

postconditions: All customizations applied: variant index 2, iridescence adjusted, lighting customized, lamp repositioned
Scene remains stable with all customizations for 60 seconds
No errors or state corruption during extended runtime
